tagline.en: I build backend systems and keep them running in production.
tagline.id: Gua bangun sistem backend dan jaga biar tetap jalan di production.

bio.en: I design REST APIs, wire up distributed services, and automate deployments with CI/CD on my own VPS. Mostly Laravel and Node, always shipping.
bio.id: Gua desain REST API, rangkai layanan terdistribusi, dan otomatisasi deploy pakai CI/CD di VPS sendiri. Kebanyakan Laravel dan Node, selalu ngirim ke production.

lead.en: Infrastructure is invisible when it works.
lead.id: Infrastruktur nggak keliatan kalau jalan mulus.

sub.en: I care about clean APIs, reproducible deploys, and services that recover on their own. The visible part is a website. The real work is everything keeping it up.
sub.id: Gua peduli sama API yang rapi, deploy yang bisa diulang, dan layanan yang bisa pulih sendiri. Yang keliatan cuma website. Kerja sebenarnya ada di semua hal yang bikin dia tetap nyala.
